message.reasoning_content:
I need to determine the additional clockwise rotation in degrees, within the range [0, 360), to align the current object's facing direction with the reference direction.

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, which is pointing upper-right. The current object's facing direction is indicated by the direction the MAIN puzzle is facing in image 2, which is downward.

The reference direction (upper-right) can be represented by a clockwise angle of 45 degrees. The current object's facing direction (downward) can be represented by a clockwise angle of 180 degrees.

The additional clockwise rotation needed is the absolute difference between these two angles: |180 - 45| = 135 degrees.
